cohort: 281 women referred to a fetal medicine unit with a singleton non-anomalous fetus diagnosed antenatally as SGA (<10th percentile estimated fetal weight) from 36+0 weeks' gestation
finding: Implementation of a risk-stratification protocol, which included expectant management for low-risk SGA fetuses beyond 37 weeks, resulted in a lower incidence of neonatal composite adverse outcome and neonatal unit admission, as well as lower induction of labor and cesarean section rates compared to the pre-protocol period.
